title: skeleton/1 — a rest skeleton: bones with their parent and rest head and tail
description: Written by unity-rigged-character contract_map.py (`contract --out`, `bvh --out`), blender-retarget brt_arp.py (`pipeline` / `export`: <fbx>.skeleton.json, armature space after an FBX re-import), humanoid-motion twocam/skeleton.py (demo_skeleton) and the Blender dump in humanoid-contract.md; read by contract_map.py (`map`, `suggest`) and twocam/skeleton.py (`rig-info`). The skeleton/1 frame is metres, +Z up, facing -Y; a file declared `up: +Y` (a BVH header kept in its own axes) is turned on read with (x, y, z) -> (x, -z, y). contract_map.py also reads two unstamped shapes (a `bones` object keyed by name, a bare list of bones); a stamped file is the form below. Producers add their own keys freely.

source.description: what the skeleton was read from: humanoid-contract, bvh, blender, auto-rig-pro export (FBX re-import)

up.description: +Z: the skeleton/1 frame; +Y: turned on read

forward.description: -Y in the skeleton/1 frame; +Z for a BVH kept in its own axes

units.description: m, or for a BVH `file units x S` (S the --scale applied to its offsets)

bones.description: names are unique and every parent names a bone of the list (contract_map.py refuses a file that breaks either; not expressible here)

head.description: rest head, armature space; without heads contract_map skips its position gates and twocam/skeleton.py refuses the file

deform.description: true when the bone deforms skin (brt_arp: some vertex is weighted to it); default true

channels.description: a BVH joint's CHANNELS; a root with position channels carries translation

matrix_local.description: optional rest matrix (armature space, rows), with the bone's roll; twocam/skeleton.py builds a roll-0 one without it
